subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw allow sandboxed dashboard widgets to translate A2UI actions into dashboard data and prompt gates, and under what manifest/security constraints?
rationale: The feature crosses the dashboard sandbox, Canvas/A2UI action protocol, and operator action gates, so automation cannot choose the product/security contract safely.

options.title: Keep as gated roadmap work
options.body: Retain this issue while the dashboard host and web A2UI bridge mature, then require a focused security-reviewed implementation.

options.title: Narrow to Canvas web bridge first
options.body: Defer dashboard integration until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 defines the browser A2UI action protocol.

options.title: Move out of core dashboard
options.body: If maintainers do not want a bundled dashboard bridge, route this as an external widget/plugin experiment rather than core OpenClaw work.

recommendation.title: Keep as gated roadmap work
recommendation.body: Retain this issue while the dashboard host and web A2UI bridge mature, then require a focused security-reviewed implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main history signal for the generic plugin-tab and Canvas/A2UI surfaces involved in the decision.
